text.en:
Section six of Act Numbered Two thousand and ninety-five of the Philippine Legislature is
hereby amended to read as follows:
"Section 6. The holders of fellowships under this Act shall each receive, m monthly or quarterly installments
one thousand two hundred pesos per annum and their tuition fees; they shall further be entitled to
reimbursement of actual and necessary expenses for travel and subsistence to and from their homes in the
Philippine Islands and their respective places of study in America or Europe and for such textbooks,
stationery, and use of implements, instruments, apparatus, and paraphernalia as may be necessary for them to
pursue with profit their respective courses of study. They shall also be entitled to reimbursement of expenses
for medical fees, hospital attendance, and nurse hire in all cases in which it may have been necessary to

Enacted, February 3, 1914.
